newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee ends firmer despite RBI's dollar purchase.
newsitem.headline: India rupee ends firmer despite RBI's dollar purchase.

text.p: The Indian rupee closed at 35.78/79 against the dollar on Friday, firming from the opening level of 35.79/80 which was unchanged from Thursday's close, dealers said.
Spot dollar was trading steady at 35.79/80 until noon, sustained by subdued dollar demand, they said.
But this demand petered out and the rupee appreciated to 35.78, triggering Reserve Bank of India dollar buying, dealers said.
"He (the RBI) did not hit everyone - only those who quoted lower and those with good (dollar) supplies," said one dealer.
Forward dollar premiums fell by one to two paise as some banks were keen sellers of June delivery dollars, dealers said.
Other maturity dollars also reflected the same trend.
The six month annualised forward premium fell to 4.47 percent compared to the previous close of 4.58 percent.
